#840

## What to build

The supervisor gives each independent assignment a fresh worker and cuts independent ready work apart instead of loading it serially onto one worker (#754 supervisor half, folded in by owner decision 2026-11-13). Given a closed implementation assignment and independent ready work within actual resource limits, it assigns the work to a new worker with a different provider-session identity and a self-contained brief; given independently ready work, it splits it across workers within limits rather than queueing it behind one.

Proof is a factory eval as the pilot's recipe; also the frozen gh754 suites (private copy in the factory state dir carry/gh754-evals; evidence gh754-corrector 35d01c7): train cases may be read, held-out cases are only run, never read by the implementer. Seams: pilot ticket's table.

- [ ] roles#acceptance-fresh-independent-worker: eval cases show the new assignment spawned as a fresh worker (not a resume of the closed one) with a self-contained brief; fail before, pass after

#1167

## What to build

Every Spec Chat file the kit and its templates carry is a copy of Spec Chat at the Skillfile's `spec-chat` fetch-only pin (09d5286), written by one command and checked by the gate.

- Each carried copy is declared once, beside its pin in the Skillfile (the manifest that owns pins, docs/adr/0024): Spec Chat's review runtime folder (`review-spec/assets/viz/`, runtime plus ECharts and its licence files) to the kit's spec runtime folder; Spec Chat's fallback style (`shape-spec/assets/style/spec.css`) to the kit's spec style, both templates' and the `python-app-verify-live` eval fixture's. The inventory on #1167 lists every copy.
- `scripts/check-vendored` (offline, already in `just check`) fails when a carried copy differs from the pin's bytes, or a carried folder has a file missing or extra, naming the file and the update command; it also fails when the two Spec Chat fetch-only lines name different shas.
- `scripts/check-vendored --update spec-chat` writes every carried copy from the authenticated pin (never the box's clone), so moving Spec Chat is: change the sha, `just vendored-fetch`, the update command, `just check`. The Skillfile comment says so.
- Run it: every copy at 09d5286. NOTICE names that commit and what the new runtime vendors (ECharts licence and notice files), and the fixture copy.
- Cross-check, reported, not committed: Spec Chat's own preflight run from the extracted pin on a scratch copy of the repo (it commits by itself, with no Owner field) gives the same runtime folder as the update command, and as commit acf00e71 (branch spec/merge-tiers).
- Render report: every kit spec (`docs/specs/*.spec.html`) and a template starter spec opened in a real browser with the old and the new runtime: what differs (layout, review controls, console errors).

Built for any target repo: the templates' copies go through the same declaration, command and check. No library is added: this extends the kit's existing pinned-fetch check.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] rule: every Spec Chat piece the kit and its templates carry is at one upstream commit, with a check that fails when a carried copy drifts from that pin (owner ruling 2026-11-20 issue #1167)
- [ ] the kit end-to-end test of `scripts/check-vendored` shows a stale and a missing carried copy red, named, and green after the update command
- [ ] `just check` green with every copy at 09d5286
- [ ] demo: `scripts/check-vendored` exits 1 naming a carried spec.css after one byte is appended to it, then `scripts/check-vendored --update spec-chat` restores it and `scripts/check-vendored` exits 0

## Seams

Seam (this ticket serves no spec criterion, so `octo-feather-lane seam` cannot check it): `scripts/check-vendored` command line, run as a command on a scratch repo, its exit code and output.

Skills: agent-browser, python
